decisions.Subject: Lead design
decisions.Decision / Revision: Favorite-1.0 is the active lead design.
decisions.Reason: User selected the corrected concept as the preferred direction.

decisions.Subject: Coordinate origin
decisions.Decision / Revision: 0,0 is the rear-left fence intersection beside the large boulder.
decisions.Reason: Keeps property features in positive coordinates and uses a permanent boundary landmark.
decisions.Notes: Origin is the fence corner, not the boulder itself.

decisions.Subject: Coordinate axes
decisions.Decision / Revision: +X runs toward the gate side; +Y runs toward the house/deck.
decisions.Reason: Provides a consistent positive-coordinate survey grid.

decisions.Subject: Drainage intent
decisions.Decision / Revision: Design slope is toward the gate side, subject to elevation verification.
decisions.Notes: Must not discharge onto neighbouring property.

decisions.Subject: Shelter
decisions.Decision / Revision: Bug/rain protection remains a required feature.
decisions.Reason: Supports evening use in a shaded, mosquito-prone yard.

decisions.Subject: Lighting
decisions.Decision / Revision: Hardwired dimmable lighting remains in scope for design and costing.
decisions.Reason: User requested adjustable intensity and permanent lighting capability.
decisions.Notes: Licensed electrician to confirm line-voltage work.

decisions.Subject: Daily planning assumptions
decisions.Decision / Revision: Schedule starts 2026-06-29, uses 7 days/week at 8 hours/day, assumes one primary worker, and covers only through the preliminary BOM.
decisions.Notes: No construction tasks are included in this revision.

decisions.Subject: Schedule release target
decisions.Decision / Revision: Preliminary BOM R01 is planned for 2026-08-10, leaving August 11–30 as deadline-protection reserve.
decisions.Reason: Provides 20 calendar days of contingency before the 2026-08-30 deadline.
decisions.Notes: Reserve days remain at zero planned hours unless activated.

decisions.Subject: Boundary control
